findings.excerpt: Then that finite-budget algorithm terminates ... returning \texttt{inconclusive}, \texttt{budget-exhausted}, or \texttt{certified}. ... [F7] The algorithm issues \texttt{certified} ...
findings.symptom: The source-authored LaTeX command \texttt{...} appears literally in rendered prose instead of formatting the status tokens as code. The occurrence is visible in the Statement and Facts & Assumptions on tile 01 and in the Proof on tile 02.
findings.suggested_repair: Use Markdown code spans (`inconclusive`, `budget-exhausted`, `certified`) for prose status names, or wrap each LaTeX command in inline math only if mathematical roman text is intended.

diagram_candidates.kind: potential TikZ projector Grassmann chart and tangent schematic
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The Statement explicitly defines nearby subspaces as graphs V_X over U and gives both the projector formula and the off-diagonal block form of every tangent direction at P_0.
diagram_candidates.specific_content_to_draw: Show the orthogonal splitting C^n=U⊕U^⊥, the reference subspace U, a nearby graph V_X={u+Xu}, and the projection π_U|_V identifying graph coordinates X. Beside it, show a tangent block matrix with zero diagonal blocks and B,B* off diagonal. Keep the schematic dimension agnostic and complex adjoints explicit; do not suggest the drawing proves chart openness or the projector formula.
diagram_candidates.certainty: optional editorial candidate; the chart and tangent maps are explicit in source, and no omission defect is confirmed

diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The example states that every rank-one line in span(e_1,e_2) minimizes the Rayleigh quotient and explicitly parameterizes the family over 0≤θ<π.
diagram_candidates.specific_content_to_draw: Show the e_1e_2 plane as the zero-eigenspace of diag(0,0,2), with lines [cos θ e_1+sin θ e_2] for 0≤θ<π as distinct points/representatives of a continuous family in Gr(1,3); show e_3 as the positive eigen-direction. Identify antipodal unit vectors as the same line so the parameter interval is half-open and endpoints are not duplicated.
diagram_candidates.certainty: optional editorial candidate; source directly supports the family and its quotient identification, but no omission defect is confirmed
